title: 石子游戏 V
summary: 反复把石子数组切成非空两段，丢弃和较大段并获得较小段的和；相等时任选一段，求最大总分。
insight: 区间 DP 枚举第一刀。左右和较小时下一状态被唯一确定；相等时选择两侧 DP 更优者。前缀和常数时间计算区间和。
pitfalls: 得到的分数是保留段的和
两段和相等时可选任一侧
单元素区间不能再切得分零

solutions.title: 区间切分博弈动态规划
solutions.idea: 按区间长度自底向上枚举所有第一刀。
steps: length 从二递增，split 从 left 到 right-1，计算 leftSum、rightSum
较小侧 sum+对应 dp；相等取 sum+max(两侧 dp)，更新区间最优

code.java: class Solution { public int stoneGameV(int[] stoneValue){int n=stoneValue.length;int[] prefix=new int[n+1];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)prefix[i+1]=prefix[i]+stoneValue[i];int[][] dp=new int[n][n];for(int length=2;length<=n;length++)for(int left=0;left+length<=n;left++){int right=left+length-1;for(int split=left;split<right;split++){int leftSum=prefix[split+1]-prefix[left],rightSum=prefix[right+1]-prefix[split+1];if(leftSum<rightSum)dp[left][right]=Math.max(dp[left][right],leftSum+dp[left][split]);else if(leftSum>rightSum)dp[left][right]=Math.max(dp[left][right],rightSum+dp[split+1][right]);else dp[left][right]=Math.max(dp[left][right],leftSum+Math.max(dp[left][split],dp[split+1][right]));}}return dp[0][n-1];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun stoneGameV(stoneValue:IntArray):Int{val n=stoneValue.size;val prefix=IntArray(n+1);for(i in stoneValue.indices)prefix[i+1]=prefix[i]+stoneValue[i];val dp=Array(n){IntArray(n)};for(length in 2..n)for(left in 0..n-length){val right=left+length-1;for(split in left until right){val leftSum=prefix[split+1]-prefix[left];val rightSum=prefix[right+1]-prefix[split+1];val candidate=if(leftSum<rightSum)leftSum+dp[left][split]else if(leftSum>rightSum)rightSum+dp[split+1][right]else leftSum+maxOf(dp[left][split],dp[split+1][right]);dp[left][right]=maxOf(dp[left][right],candidate)}};return dp[0][n-1]} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int stoneGameV(vector<int>& stoneValue){int n=stoneValue.size();vector<int> prefix(n+1);for(int i=0;i<n;++i)prefix[i+1]=prefix[i]+stoneValue[i];vector<vector<int>> dp(n,vector<int>(n));for(int length=2;length<=n;++length)for(int left=0;left+length<=n;++left){int right=left+length-1;for(int split=left;split<right;++split){int leftSum=prefix[split+1]-prefix[left],rightSum=prefix[right+1]-prefix[split+1],candidate;if(leftSum<rightSum)candidate=leftSum+dp[left][split];else if(leftSum>rightSum)candidate=rightSum+dp[split+1][right];else candidate=leftSum+max(dp[left][split],dp[split+1][right]);dp[left][right]=max(dp[left][right],candidate);}}return dp[0][n-1];} };
